title: [Subcontracting] Refactor event subscriber for planning components and add test for Vendor-supplied components
summary: Vendor-supplied components in subcontracting no longer generate separate planning demand but still appear in the planning worksheet for consumption registration. The subscriber now hooks OnAfterFilterLinesWithItemToPlan on Planning Component instead of OnTransferBOMOnBeforeUpdatePlanningComp, and a test covers the behaviour.
key_points: Subscriber moved from OnTransferBOMOnBeforeUpdatePlanningComp to OnAfterFilterLinesWithItemToPlan on Planning Component
Components with supply method Vendor-Supplied are filtered out so they create no separate requisition lines
Vendor-supplied components remain in the planning worksheet and production order for consumption tracking
New test confirms the component is planned again when its supply method changes
